title: personal.json drafts
description: The unsent drafts of the person (drafts): per thread, or per forum channel for a new post, the own text, the quoted message and the IDs of the attached uploads that are not sent yet (their bytes are under files/). Channels, threads and messages appear only by ID.

thread_id.description: ID of the thread; absent for the draft of a new forum post.

reply_to_message_id.description: ID of the quoted message; absent for none.

file_ids.description: IDs of the uploads attached to the draft.

updated_by_device_id.description: ID of the own device of the last change; absent when unknown.
